verses.original: שִׁמְע֣וּ אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָ֛ה דִּבֶּ֧ר עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer Yah·weh dib·ber ‘ă·lê·ḵem bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Hear - the word that the LORD speaks to you O house of Israel

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־ אָמַ֣ר אַל־ תִּלְמָ֔דוּ דֶּ֤רֶךְ הַגּוֹיִם֙ תֵּחָ֑תּוּ וּמֵאֹת֥וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם אַל־ כִּֽי־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם יֵחַ֥תּוּ מֵהֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh Yah·weh ’el- ’ā·mar ’al- til·mā·ḏū de·reḵ hag·gō·w·yim tê·ḥāt·tū ū·mê·’ō·ṯō·wṯ haš·šā·ma·yim ’al- kî- hag·gō·w·yim yê·ḥat·tū mê·hêm·māh
verses.literal: This is what the LORD . . . says Do not learn the ways of the nations or be terrified by the signs in the heavens . . . though the nations [themselves] are terrified by them

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חֻקּ֥וֹת הָֽעַמִּ֖ים הֶ֣בֶל ה֑וּא כִּֽי־ כְּרָת֔וֹ עֵץ֙ מִיַּ֣עַר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה בַּֽמַּעֲצָֽד׃ יְדֵ֥י־ חָרָ֖שׁ
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥuq·qō·wṯ hā·‘am·mîm he·ḇel hū kî- kə·rā·ṯōw ‘êṣ mî·ya·‘ar ma·‘ă·śêh bam·ma·‘ă·ṣāḏ yə·ḏê- ḥā·rāš
verses.literal: For the customs of the peoples are worthless . . . . . . they cut down a tree from the forest it is shaped with a chisel by the hands of a craftsman

verses.original: יְיַפֵּ֑הוּ בְּכֶ֥סֶף וּבְזָהָ֖ב יְחַזְּק֖וּם וּבְמַקָּב֛וֹת בְּמַסְמְר֧וֹת וְל֥וֹא יָפִֽיק׃
verses.transliteration: yə·yap·pê·hū bə·ḵe·sep̄ ū·ḇə·zā·hāḇ yə·ḥaz·zə·qūm ū·ḇə·maq·qā·ḇō·wṯ bə·mas·mə·rō·wṯ wə·lō·w yā·p̄îq
verses.literal: They adorn it with silver and gold and fasten it with hammer and nails so that it will not totter

verses.original: כְּתֹ֨מֶר מִקְשָׁ֥ה הֵ֙מָּה֙ וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ נָשׂ֥וֹא יִנָּשׂ֖וּא כִּ֣י לֹ֣א יִצְעָ֑דוּ אַל־ תִּֽירְא֤וּ מֵהֶם֙ כִּי־ לֹ֣א יָרֵ֔עוּ וְגַם־ אֵ֥ין אוֹתָֽם׃ס הֵיטֵ֖יב
verses.transliteration: kə·ṯō·mer miq·šāh hêm·māh wə·lō yə·ḏab·bê·rū nā·śō·w yin·nā·śū kî lō yiṣ·‘ā·ḏū ’al- tî·rə·’ū mê·hem kî- lō yā·rê·‘ū wə·ḡam- ’ên ’ō·w·ṯām hê·ṭêḇ
verses.literal: Like scarecrows in a cucumber patch their idols cannot speak They must be carried . . . because they cannot walk Do not fear them for they can do no harm and neither can they . . . do any good

verses.original: מֵאֵ֥ין כָּמ֖וֹךָ יְהוָ֑ה אַתָּ֛ה גָּד֥וֹל שִׁמְךָ֖ וְגָד֥וֹל בִּגְבוּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mê·’ên kā·mō·w·ḵā Yah·weh ’at·tāh gā·ḏō·wl šim·ḵā wə·ḡā·ḏō·wl biḡ·ḇū·rāh
verses.literal: There is none like You O LORD You are great and Your name is mighty in power

verses.original: מִ֣י לֹ֤א יִֽרָאֲךָ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם כִּ֥י יָאָ֑תָה לְךָ֖ כִּ֣י בְכָל־ חַכְמֵ֧י הַגּוֹיִ֛ם וּבְכָל־ מַלְכוּתָ֖ם מֵאֵ֥ין כָּמֽוֹךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mî lō yi·rā·’ă·ḵā me·leḵ hag·gō·w·yim kî yā·’ā·ṯāh lə·ḵā kî ḇə·ḵāl- ḥaḵ·mê hag·gō·w·yim ū·ḇə·ḵāl mal·ḵū·ṯām mê·’ên kā·mō·w·ḵā
verses.literal: Who would not fear You O King of nations This is Your due For among all the wise [men] of the nations and in all their kingdoms there is none like You

verses.original: וּבְאַחַ֖ת יִבְעֲר֣וּ וְיִכְסָ֑לוּ מוּסַ֥ר הֲבָלִ֖ים עֵ֥ץ הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·’a·ḥaṯ yiḇ·‘ă·rū wə·yiḵ·sā·lū mū·sar hă·ḇā·lîm ‘êṣ hū
verses.literal: But they are altogether senseless and foolish instructed by worthless idols made of wood . . .

verses.original: מְרֻקָּ֞ע כֶּ֣סֶף יוּבָ֗א מִתַּרְשִׁ֣ישׁ וְזָהָב֙ מֵֽאוּפָ֔ז מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חָרָ֖שׁ וִידֵ֣י צוֹרֵ֑ף לְבוּשָׁ֔ם תְּכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ כֻּלָּֽם׃ מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֲכָמִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: mə·ruq·qā‘ ke·sep̄ yū·ḇā mit·tar·šîš wə·zā·hāḇ mê·’ū·p̄āz ma·‘ă·śêh ḥā·rāš wî·ḏê ṣō·w·rêp̄ lə·ḇū·šām tə·ḵê·leṯ wə·’ar·gā·mān kul·lām ma·‘ă·śêh ḥă·ḵā·mîm
verses.literal: Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish and gold from Uphaz the work of a craftsman from the hands of a goldsmith Their clothes are blue and purple all fashioned by skilled workers

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֤ה אֱמֶ֔ת אֱלֹהִים֙ הֽוּא־ חַיִּ֖ים אֱלֹהִ֥ים עוֹלָ֑ם וּמֶ֣לֶךְ הָאָ֔רֶץ תִּרְעַ֣שׁ מִקִּצְפּוֹ֙ גוֹיִ֖ם וְלֹֽא־ יָכִ֥לוּ זַעְמֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·meṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm hū- ḥay·yîm ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘ō·w·lām ū·me·leḵ hā·’ā·reṣ tir·‘aš miq·qiṣ·pōw ḡō·w·yim wə·lō- yā·ḵi·lū za‘·mōw
verses.literal: But the LORD is the true God He is the living God and eternal King The earth quakes at His wrath and the nations cannot endure His indignation

verses.original: כִּדְנָה֙ תֵּאמְר֣וּן לְה֔וֹם אֱלָ֣הַיָּ֔א דִּֽי־ עֲבַ֑דוּ לָ֣א שְׁמַיָּ֥א וְאַרְקָ֖א יֵאבַ֧דוּ מֵֽאַרְעָ֛א וּמִן־ תְּח֥וֹת אֵֽלֶּה׃ס שְׁמַיָּ֖א
verses.transliteration: kiḏ·nāh tê·mə·rūn lə·hō·wm ’ĕ·lā·hay·yā dî- ‘ă·ḇa·ḏū lā šə·may·yā wə·’ar·qā yê·ḇa·ḏū mê·’ar·‘ā ū·min- tə·ḥō·wṯ ’êl·leh šə·may·yā
verses.literal: Thus you are to tell them [These] gods who have made neither the heavens [nor] the earth will perish from this earth and from under these heavens

verses.original: עֹשֵׂ֥ה אֶ֙רֶץ֙ בְּכֹח֔וֹ מֵכִ֥ין תֵּבֵ֖ל בְּחָכְמָת֑וֹ נָטָ֥ה שָׁמָֽיִם׃ וּבִתְבוּנָת֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·śêh ’e·reṣ bə·ḵō·ḥōw mê·ḵîn tê·ḇêl bə·ḥā·ḵə·mā·ṯōw nā·ṭāh šā·mā·yim ū·ḇiṯ·ḇū·nā·ṯōw
verses.literal: [The LORD] made the earth by His power He established the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding

verses.original: לְק֨וֹל תִּתּ֜וֹ מַ֙יִם֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֔יִם הֲמ֥וֹן נְשִׂאִ֖ים וַיַּעֲלֶ֥ה מִקְצֵ֣ה אֶרֶץ עָשָׂ֔ה בְּרָקִ֤ים לַמָּטָר֙ וַיּ֥וֹצֵא ר֖וּחַ מֵאֹצְרֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lə·qō·wl tit·tōw ma·yim baš·šā·ma·yim hă·mō·wn nə·śi·’îm way·ya·‘ă·leh miq·ṣêh ʾɛ·rɛṣ ‘ā·śāh bə·rā·qîm lam·mā·ṭār way·yō·w·ṣê rū·aḥ mê·’ō·ṣə·rō·ṯāw
verses.literal: When He thunders . . . the waters in the heavens roar He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses

verses.original: כָּל־ אָדָם֙ נִבְעַ֤ר מִדַּ֔עַת כָּל־ צוֹרֵ֖ף הֹבִ֥ישׁ מִפָּ֑סֶל כִּ֛י נִסְכּ֖וֹ שֶׁ֥קֶר וְלֹא־ ר֥וּחַ בָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’ā·ḏām niḇ·‘ar mid·da·‘aṯ kāl- ṣō·w·rêp̄ hō·ḇîš mip·pā·sel kî nis·kōw še·qer wə·lō- rū·aḥ bām
verses.literal: Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols For his molten images are a fraud and [there is] no breath in them

verses.original: הֵ֔מָּה הֶ֣בֶל מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה תַּעְתֻּעִ֑ים בְּעֵ֥ת פְּקֻדָּתָ֖ם יֹאבֵֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh he·ḇel ma·‘ă·śêh ta‘·tu·‘îm bə·‘êṯ pə·qud·dā·ṯām yō·ḇê·ḏū
verses.literal: They are worthless a work to be mocked In the time of their punishment they will perish

verses.original: חֵ֣לֶק יַעֲקֹ֗ב לֹֽא־ כְאֵ֜לֶּה כִּֽי־ ה֔וּא יוֹצֵ֤ר הַכֹּל֙ וְיִ֨שְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֵׁ֖בֶט נַֽחֲלָת֑וֹ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥê·leq ya·‘ă·qōḇ lō- ḵə·’êl·leh kî- hū yō·w·ṣêr hak·kōl wə·yiś·rā·’êl šê·ḇeṭ na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ šə·mōw
verses.literal: The Portion of Jacob is not like these for He is the Maker of all things and Israel [is] the tribe of His inheritance the LORD of Hosts is His name

verses.original: אִסְפִּ֥י כִּנְעָתֵ֑ךְ מֵאֶ֖רֶץ יֹשַׁבְתִּי בַּמָּצֽוֹר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’is·pî kin·‘ā·ṯêḵ mê·’e·reṣ yō·šaḇ·tī bam·mā·ṣō·wr
verses.literal: Gather up your belongings from this land you who live under siege

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כֹה֙ יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר הִנְנִ֥י הַזֹּ֑את בַּפַּ֣עַם קוֹלֵ֛עַ אֶת־ יוֹשְׁבֵ֥י הָאָ֖רֶץ וַהֲצֵר֥וֹתִי לָהֶ֖ם לְמַ֥עַן יִמְצָֽאוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- ḵōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar hin·nî haz·zōṯ bap·pa·‘am qō·w·lê·a‘ ’eṯ- yō·wō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ wa·hă·ṣê·rō·w·ṯî lā·hem lə·ma·‘an yim·ṣā·’ū
verses.literal: For this is what the LORD says Behold at this time I will sling out - the inhabitants of the land and bring distress upon them so that they may be captured

verses.original: א֥וֹי לִי֙ עַל־ שִׁבְרִ֔י מַכָּתִ֑י נַחְלָ֖ה וַאֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי אַ֛ךְ זֶ֥ה חֳלִ֖י וְאֶשָּׂאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w lî ‘al- šiḇ·rî mak·kā·ṯî naḥ·lāh wa·’ă·nî ’ā·mar·tî ’aḵ zeh ḥo·lî wə·’eś·śā·’en·nū
verses.literal: Woe to me because of my brokenness my wound is grievous But I said . . . This is truly my sickness and I must bear it

verses.original: אָהֳלִ֣י שֻׁדָּ֔ד וְכָל־ מֵיתָרַ֖י נִתָּ֑קוּ בָּנַ֤י יְצָאֻ֙נִי֙ וְאֵינָ֔ם אֵין־ עוֹד֙ נֹטֶ֥ה אָהֳלִ֔י וּמֵקִ֖ים יְרִיעוֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ho·lî šud·dāḏ wə·ḵāl mê·ṯā·ray nit·tā·qū bā·nay yə·ṣā·’u·nî wə·’ê·nām ’ên- ‘ō·wḏ nō·ṭeh ’ā·ho·lî ū·mê·qîm yə·rî·‘ō·w·ṯāy
verses.literal: My tent is destroyed and all its ropes are snapped My sons have departed from me and are no more I have no one left to pitch my tent or set up my curtains

verses.original: כִּ֤י הָֽרֹעִ֔ים נִבְעֲרוּ֙ וְאֶת־ לֹ֣א דָרָ֑שׁוּ יְהוָ֖ה עַל־ כֵּן֙ לֹ֣א הִשְׂכִּ֔ילוּ וְכָל־ מַרְעִיתָ֖ם נָפֽוֹצָה׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî hā·rō·‘îm niḇ·‘ă·rū wə·’eṯ- lō ḏā·rā·šū Yah·weh ‘al- kên lō hiś·kî·lū wə·ḵāl mar·‘î·ṯām nā·p̄ō·w·ṣāh
verses.literal: For the shepherds have become senseless - they do not seek the LORD Therefore . . . they have not prospered and all their flock is scattered

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה ק֤וֹל שְׁמוּעָה֙ בָאָ֔ה גָּד֖וֹל וְרַ֥עַשׁ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֑וֹן לָשׂ֞וּם אֶת־ עָרֵ֧י יְהוּדָ֛ה שְׁמָמָ֖ה מְע֥וֹן תַּנִּֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh qō·wl šə·mū·‘āh ḇā·’āh gā·ḏō·wl wə·ra·‘aš mê·’e·reṣ ṣā·p̄ō·wn lā·śūm ’eṯ- ‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh šə·mā·māh mə·‘ō·wn tan·nîm
verses.literal: Listen The sound of a report is coming a great commotion from the land to the north It will make - the cities of Judah a desolation a haunt for jackals

verses.original: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֛י לָאָדָ֖ם דַּרְכּ֑וֹ לֹ֥א לֹֽא־ לְאִ֣ישׁ הֹלֵ֔ךְ וְהָכִ֖ין אֶֽת־ צַעֲדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏa‘·tî Yah·weh kî lā·’ā·ḏām dar·kōw lō lō- lə·’îš hō·lêḵ wə·hā·ḵîn ’eṯ- ṣa·‘ă·ḏōw
verses.literal: I know O LORD that a man’s way is not his own no one who walks directs - his own steps

verses.original: יַסְּרֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה אַךְ־ בְּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט אַל־ בְּאַפְּךָ֖ פֶּן־ תַּמְעִטֵֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: yas·sə·rê·nî Yah·weh ’aḵ- bə·miš·pāṭ ’al- bə·’ap·pə·ḵā pen- tam·‘i·ṭê·nî
verses.literal: Correct me O LORD but only with justice — not in Your anger or You will bring me to nothing

verses.original: שְׁפֹ֣ךְ חֲמָתְךָ֗ עַל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ יְדָע֔וּךָ וְעַל֙ מִשְׁפָּח֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹ֣א קָרָ֑אוּ בְּשִׁמְךָ֖ כִּֽי־ אָכְל֣וּ אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֗ב וַאֲכָלֻ֙הוּ֙ וַיְכַלֻּ֔הוּ וְאֶת־ הֵשַֽׁמּוּ׃פ נָוֵ֖הוּ
verses.transliteration: šə·p̄ōḵ ḥă·mā·ṯə·ḵā ‘al- hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer lō- yə·ḏā·‘ū·ḵā wə·‘al miš·pā·ḥō·wṯ ’ă·šer lō qā·rā·’ū bə·šim·ḵā kî- ’ā·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ wa·’ă·ḵā·lu·hū way·ḵal·lu·hū wə·’eṯ- hê·šam·mū nā·wê·hū
verses.literal: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You and on the families that do not call on Your name For they have devoured - Jacob they have consumed him and finished him off - they have devastated his homeland
